components.name: Navigation
components.description: Navy navigation with rust current-page state.
components.css: .ds-nav{font-family:'Encode Sans Variable',sans-serif;background:var(--navy,#182c3d);padding:14px;display:grid;gap:10px}.ds-nav a{padding:12px 15px;color:#f2f5f6;font-size:17px;border-radius:4px;min-height:50px;text-decoration:none;transition:background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-nav a:hover{background:#2b4254}.ds-nav a.ds-active{background:var(--rust,#b94d28);color:#fff}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--rust,#b94d28);outline-offset:4px;}

narrative.overview:
Operations Desk pairs a persistent navy navigation anchor with an ivory work surface and white, finely ruled reports. Rust marks active navigation, actions, and the traffic line. The result is calm, practical, and deliberately flat.

Self-hosted Encode Sans carries both headings and dense report text. Strong totals, tabular numerals, and restrained supporting labels establish hierarchy without ornamental imagery. Data, account, loading, and empty states use the same materials.
keyCharacteristics: White panels with fine rules and modest corners
Rust for selection, actions, and chart emphasis
Readable report hierarchy with tabular numerals

rules.name: The Flat Desk Rule
rules.body: Separate report surfaces with white fill and fine borders; do not add decorative panel shadows.

rules.name: The Readable Totals Rule
rules.body: Use tabular numerals for aligned measurements and retain explicit labels beside each total.

dos: Do retain navy navigation, ivory canvas, and white report surfaces.
Do use the rust focus outline and visible labels for controls.
Do preserve context and readable empty states while reports load.
Do let long domains wrap or truncate deliberately and keep numeric columns aligned.
donts: Don't introduce gradients, glass, or decorative shadows into report panels.
Don't replace actual report values or missing data with illustrative metrics.
Don't add prior-period deltas unless the underlying comparison is available.
